title: Improving Outdoor Multi-cell Fingerprinting-based Positioning via Mobile Data Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2509.19405v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate outdoor positioning in cellular networks is hindered by sparse, heterogeneous measurement collections and the high cost of exhaustive site surveys. This paper introduces a lightweight, modular mobile data augmentation framework designed to enhance multi-cell fingerprinting-based positioning using operator-collected minimization of drive test (MDT) records. The proposed approach decouples spatial and radio-feature synthesis: kernel density estimation (KDE) models the empirical spatial distribution to generate geographically coherent synthetic locations, while a 1-nearest-neighbor (1NN)-based block produces augmented per-cell radio fingerprints. The architecture is intentionally training-free, interpretable, and suitable for distributed or on-premise operator deployments, supporting privacy-aware workflows. translated_title: 通过移动数据增强改进基于多小区指纹的室外定位
translated_abstract: 蜂窝网络中精确的室外定位受到稀疏、异构的测量数据采集以及详尽站点勘测高昂成本的阻碍。本文提出了一种轻量级、模块化的移动数据增强框架，旨在利用运营商采集的最小化路测（MDT）记录来增强基于多小区指纹的定位。所提方法将空间合成与无线电特征合成进行解耦：核密度估计（KDE）对经验空间分布进行建模，以生成地理上连贯的合成位置；而基于1-最近邻（1NN）的模块则生成增强的每小区无线电指纹。该架构特意设计为免训练、可解释，并适用于分布式或本地部署的运营商环境，支持隐私感知的工作流程。我们既对每个增强模块进行了独立验证，也评估了其对基于指纹定位的端到端影响。
tldr: 该论文提出一种免训练、模块化的移动数据增强框架，利用核密度估计生成地理连贯的合成位置，并结合基于1-最近邻的小区无线电指纹增强方法，从而借助运营商MDT记录提升基于多小区指纹的室外定位精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight, training-free mobile data augmentation framework that combines KDE-based synthetic location generation with 1NN-based per-cell radio fingerprint enhancement to improve multi-cell fingerprinting-based outdoor positioning using operator-collected MDT records.
